A '''secret meeting room''' was located within the [[Institute of Government Service]] on the planet of [[New Apsolon/Legends|New Apsolon]] in [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]]. A meeting was to be held between the [[Absolutes]], [[Workers]] and the [[Civilized]] with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tahl]] acting as a mediator. Unfortunately, [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief of Security]] and Absolutist [[Balog (Human)|Balog]] had kidnapped Tahl and set off for his secret base.

The enraged [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], discovered the treachery and found Tahl's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in a small bin. Jinn used [[Qui-Gon Jinn's lightsaber/Legends|his lightsaber]] to destroy a table and vowed they would find Tahl.
